sections.title: Inmunización contra la Hepatitis B

summary.text: Opens the Spanish WHO fact sheet on hepatitis B immunisation by describing the global burden, with about 2000 million people showing signs of infection and 350 million chronically infected. It notes that a safe, effective vaccine has been used for nearly 20 years and could prevent most hepatitis B deaths.

sections.extract: la Hepatitis B Antecedentes La hepatitis B (HepB) constituye uno de los principales problemas de salud pública en el mundo. Un 30% de la población mundial (cerca de 2000 millones de personas) muestra signos serológicos de infección por el virus de la hepatitis B (VHB). Se estima que, de esas personas, 350 millones están infectadas crónicamente por el VHB, y cada año aproximadamente un millón de ellas muere a causa

summary.text: Sets out, in Spanish, hepatitis B immunisation strategies, prioritising routine infant vaccination with a birth dose where perinatal infection is common. It covers catch-up vaccination in low-endemicity countries, the use of monovalent and combination vaccines, and three schedule options aligned with DTP visits. It ends with advice on using vaccine introduction to strengthen immunisation services and on budgeting, plus publication details (Geneva, 2002). The extracted text repeats some words several times because of layout effects.
